name: Mini RTS
hook: Gather, build, train an army. Last base standing wins.
how: Workers dig gold and chop wood; spend it on a barracks, towers and three kinds of soldiers. Spearmen beat riders, riders beat archers, archers beat spearmen: build the right army and destroy the other Town Halls.
controls: Click or drag a box to select, right-click to move, attack or gather, WASD to look around; touch: tap to select, tap the map to send, drag to look around
uses: The most enemy units and buildings each player's base destroyed in a match.
Bots run every base nobody plays: they build up, counter your army and attack in waves.
The host's browser runs every unit and checks every order; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone sees the same units moving and fighting.
ideas: Make it a space war with ships and asteroid mining
Add a fourth unit, a catapult that's great against buildings
Hide the map until your units have seen it
